audit_observations.suspected_wrong_component_contract: The repair prompt contract identifies StatCard and its props instead of the default-exported TaskManager in this multi-component Vue SFC.

audit_observations.duplicate_class_attributes: The final San template contains elements with both a static class attribute and a generated dynamic class attribute, allowing the static class to be lost.
audit_observations.decision: Do not count this run as passing. Diagnose and test the extractor and validator before a deliberate forced rerun.
